description: Project scaffold + config/identity + boot foundation. Creates the PlatformIO project (env ttgo-t-beam-ews), the single-source pin map, the Configuration struct loaded from JSON on SPIFFS with the CA2RXU needsRewrite migration pattern, AXP2101 power-rail init at boot, SSD1306 display (config-guarded), and WiFi STA + auto-AP fallback. Everything else depends on this. Mirror c:\aws-kiro\firm configuration.cpp/.h and wifi_utils/network_manager patterns; DROP all APRS/beacon/digi fields.
steps: Write c:\aws-kiro\EWS_YG2UFH\.worktrees\ews-firmware\firmware\platformio.ini EXACTLY as the 'Exact platformio.ini' block in .agents/tasks/plan.md: [platformio] default_envs=ttgo-t-beam-ews; [env:ttgo-t-beam-ews] platform=espressif32@6.12.0, board=ttgo-t-beam, framework=arduino, monitor_speed=115200, board_build.partitions=partitions_ews.csv, the RADIOLIB_EXCLUDE build_flags, and the lib_deps list (RadioLib, ArduinoJson@^7, PubSubClient, Adafruit BME280 + Unified Sensor, Adafruit ADS1X15, ModbusMaster, XPowersLib, TinyGPSPlus, Adafruit SSD1306 + GFX).
Write partitions_ews.csv (4MB table: nvs, otadata, app0 0x1E0000, app1 0x1E0000, spiffs, coredump) per plan.md.

Write include/board_pinout.h with ALL pins from plan.md's pin-map block (LoRa SCK=5 MISO=19 MOSI=27 CS=18 RST=23 DIO0=26; I2C SDA=21 SCL=22; I2C addrs; GPS RX=34 TX=12; MQ135=35; rain=33; anemo=32; RS485 DI=13 RO=25 DE/RE=4; DFPlayer TX=2 RX=15; MCP23017 bit map incl. ROLE_JUMPER marked IGNORED; ADS1115 channels). Add `#define HAS_SX1276`.

Write include/configuration.h: nested classes (Identity, WiFi_AP, WiFi_Auto_AP, LoRaCfg, MqttCfg, Sensors flags, Siren, Thresholds, Display) and the Configuration class with members + public setup()/setDefaultValues()/writeFile() and private readFile() + _filePath. Fields exactly per plan.md 'Config struct fields'.

Write src/configuration.cpp mirroring c:\aws-kiro\firm\src\configuration.cpp: SPIFFS.begin(false) then (true) format fallback; setup() -> if !SPIFFS.exists('/ews_conf.json') setDefaultValues()+writeFile()+delay+ESP.restart(); readFile() parses with ArduinoJson v7 JsonDocument, uses `| default` reads and sets needsRewrite=true for any null/missing field, then if needsRewrite writeFile()+ESP.restart(). setDefaultValues() fills role=0, networkId='ews1', apPassword='1234567890', LoRa freq=915000000, mqtt port=1883, intervalSec=60, missThresholdSec=180, all sensor flags false.
Write data/ews_conf.json as a default config whose shape EXACTLY matches setDefaultValues() keys (so a fresh SPIFFS upload is already valid).
Write include/display.h + src/display.cpp: SSD1306 init guarded by Config.display.enabled, plus a showStatus(const String&) helper. No-op safely when disabled.

Write include/wifi_manager.h + src/wifi_manager.cpp: connectSTA() to configured APs; startAP() softAP (SSID 'EWS-'+nodeId if set else 'YG2UFH-EWS-Setup', password from config, IP 192.168.4.1); checkWiFi() reconnect every ~30s; isConnected(); isApMode(). Mirror c:\aws-kiro\firm wifi_utils/network_manager but simplified (no backupDigi/APRS).

Write src/main.cpp: setup() -> Serial.begin(115200); Wire.begin(I2C_SDA,I2C_SCL); init AXP2101 via XPowersLib and enable LoRa+GPS power rails BEFORE anything else; Config.setup(); display init; decide AP vs STA (unconfigured/no WiFi creds -> AP). loop() currently just wifiManager.checkWiFi() + a heartbeat. Later FEATs add role dispatch and transport.
Run the build and fix any errors until green.
acceptance_criteria: `python -m platformio run -e ttgo-t-beam-ews -d c:\aws-kiro\EWS_YG2UFH\.worktrees\ews-firmware\firmware` compiles with 0 errors and reports SUCCESS.

platformio.ini, partitions_ews.csv, include/board_pinout.h, include/configuration.h, src/configuration.cpp, data/ews_conf.json, include/display.h, src/display.cpp, include/wifi_manager.h, src/wifi_manager.cpp, and src/main.cpp all exist under the worktree firmware dir.
AXP2101 is initialized in setup() before radio/GPS use; the role jumper (MCP GPB2) is NOT read for role logic anywhere.
verification: If `python -m platformio --version` fails, run `python -m pip install --upgrade platformio` then retry.
python -m platformio run -e ttgo-t-beam-ews -d c:\aws-kiro\EWS_YG2UFH\.worktrees\ews-firmware\firmware  -> must end in SUCCESS, 0 errors.
